positions.name: WeeklyRollupVsPerRunBundle
positions.frame: What does each delivery artifact for reactions carry (the per-run bundle, a weekly roll-up, a daily digest), and does one replace another so that people no longer need to scroll back?
positions.why: The four segments read in one direction: how a week's reactions should reach people. src-2 sets the per-run bundle alongside a Friday roll-up. src-3 asks whether the roll-up replaces the bundle. src-4 answers that it does not, because the bundle serves the run and the roll-up serves the week. src-5 rejects a daily digest as redundant on single-run days. The set holds a tension: src-3 questions the coexistence that src-4 settles by ruling, and the frame keeps both sides open rather than resolving them here.
